title: ALTER TABLE in SQL
definition: The ALTER TABLE statement is used to modify the structure of an existing table without deleting the table itself.

add_column.heading: Add Column
add_column.definition: Used to add a new column to an existing table.
queries: ALTER TABLE person ADD COLUMN city VARCHAR(50);
ALTER TABLE employee ADD COLUMN age INT;
ALTER TABLE student ADD COLUMN marks INT;

drop_column.heading: Drop Column
drop_column.definition: Used to remove an existing column from a table.
queries: ALTER TABLE person DROP COLUMN city;
ALTER TABLE employee DROP COLUMN age;

add_column_with_default.heading: Add Column with Default Value
add_column_with_default.definition: Adds a column and assigns a default value to existing rows.
queries: ALTER TABLE person ADD COLUMN city VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'Jodhpur';
ALTER TABLE employee ADD COLUMN status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'active';

rename_column.heading: Rename Column
rename_column.definition: Used to change the name of an existing column.
queries: ALTER TABLE person RENAME COLUMN name TO full_name;
ALTER TABLE employee RENAME COLUMN dept TO department;

rename_table.heading: Rename Table
rename_table.definition: Used to change the name of an existing table.
queries: ALTER TABLE person RENAME TO people;
ALTER TABLE employee RENAME TO employees;

change_data_type.heading: Change Data Type
change_data_type.definition: Used to modify the data type of an existing column.
queries: ALTER TABLE person ALTER COLUMN city SET DATA TYPE VARCHAR(250);
ALTER TABLE employee ALTER COLUMN salary SET DATA TYPE DECIMAL(10,2);

set_and_drop_default.heading: Set and Drop Default Value
set_and_drop_default.definition: Used to assign or remove a default value from a column.
queries: ALTER TABLE person ALTER COLUMN city SET DEFAULT 'unknown';
ALTER TABLE person ALTER COLUMN city DROP DEFAULT;

set_not_null.heading: Set NOT NULL Constraint
set_not_null.definition: Ensures that a column cannot store NULL values.
queries: ALTER TABLE person ALTER COLUMN city SET NOT NULL;
ALTER TABLE employee ALTER COLUMN salary SET NOT NULL;
